title: UAPI stability: KEY_IMPORT and KEY_GENERATE structs have no reserved bytes
description: crypto2dev_key_import_op and crypto2dev_key_generate_op have no _pad[] or _reserved[] fields. Any future extension (e.g., a key format hint, a flags-equivalent named field, or a __u64 sequence number) would require a new ioctl rather than adding a field to the existing struct. Contrast with crypto2dev_key_info which has _pad[4]. Adding _pad[8] to both structs now costs nothing and preserves extension headroom without breaking the frozen ABI. Once shipped, no padding can be added.
